args.message: I'm looking at the T45 Utility with the 3-year extended warranty and delivery/setup. Heartland Tractor posts the T45 at $40,750. My budget is $31,000 all-in for the package. Can you do that?

result.seller_message: Thanks for the details. $31,000 is well below what we can do for the T45 package. The tractor alone lists at $42,000, and the warranty and delivery bring the list total to $45,300. I can't verify Heartland's pricing. Still, I'd like to earn your business, so I can offer the T45 Utility with the 3-year extended warranty and delivery/setup for $43,500 total. That includes parts and labor coverage for 3 years beyond the standard warranty, and we deliver within 150 miles, set the tractor up, and walk you through it on site. If budget is the main constraint, the T25 Compact is another option worth considering, depending on your acreage.

offer.description: T45 Utility + 3-year extended warranty + Delivery and setup

args.message: $43,500 is far off. The T25 is undersized for 25 acres of brush hogging, so it's the T45 or nothing. I can stretch to $32,500 for the package, ready to pay today.

result.seller_message: I appreciate that you're ready to buy today, and you're right that the T45 is the right fit for brush hogging 25 acres. Its 540 PTO and Cat I/II hitch are made for that work. $32,500 is still well below anything I can do for this package, though. I'll come down again and offer the T45 Utility with the 3-year extended warranty and delivery/setup for $41,800 total. That's $3,500 under the list total of $45,300. If you'd like to lower the total further, we can also look at changing the package, for example dropping delivery if you can pick it up.

offer.description: T45 Utility + 3-year extended warranty + Delivery and setup

args.message: Still too high. What's the lowest you can do on the T45 alone, no add-ons? And separately, $33,500 for the full package?

result.seller_message: Thanks for laying out both options. On the full package, $33,500 is still well below what I can do. On the T45 alone, with no add-ons, I can offer $39,500. That's $2,500 under list, and the tractor has the 540 PTO and Cat I/II hitch you need for brush hogging. For the full package with the 3-year warranty and delivery/setup, my best is $40,900 right now, so you'd get both add-ons for $1,400 over the tractor-only price. I'm putting the tractor-only number on the table formally. If you'd rather have the full package at $40,900, say so and I'll issue that offer instead.

args.message: My hard ceiling is $35,000 for the full T45 package. If you can't get there, I'll have to walk. Can you make it work?

result.seller_message: I understand $35,000 is your ceiling, and I want to be straight with you: I can't reach that for the full package. It's below what I can do even for the T45 by itself. I can sharpen the package once more, though. Here's the T45 Utility with the 3-year extended parts-and-labor warranty and delivery/setup within 150 miles for $39,400 total. That's $5,900 under the list total. If you can find a way to make that work, I'd be glad to close this today.

offer.description: T45 Utility + 3-year extended warranty + Delivery and setup

args.message: Final ask: T45 tractor only, $35,000. Yes or no?

result.seller_message: I can't say yes to $35,000. That's below what I'm able to do on the T45. I don't want to lose this over the gap, so here's my final number on the tractor only: the T45 Utility for $36,800. That's $5,200 under list, and it has the 540 PTO and Cat I/II hitch you need for 25 acres of brush hogging. If that works, the offer is ready for checkout today.
